"""Models of the API and their enums."""

import uuid

from django.db import models


class Genre(models.TextChoices):
    """Values of Genre."""

    NOVEL = "novel", "novel"
    ESSAY = "essay", "essay"
    POETRY = "poetry", "poetry"
    SCIENCE = "science", "science"


class Author(models.Model):
    """A stored author."""

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=120)
    email = models.TextField(null=True, blank=True)
    born = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "authors"
        ordering = ["id"]


class Book(models.Model):
    """A stored book."""

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    isbn = models.TextField()
    author = models.ForeignKey("api.Author", on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    genre = models.CharField(max_length=7, choices=Genre.choices)
    pages = models.IntegerField()
    published = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    available = models.BooleanField(null=True, blank=True, default=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "books"
        ordering = ["id"]
files.api/serializers.py:
"""Serializers of the API: requests in, responses out."""

from api.models import Author, Genre
from config.validation import StrictSerializer
from django.core.validators import RegexValidator
from rest_framework import serializers


class AuthorSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """An author: what a request may send and what a response shows."""

    id = serializers.ReadOnlyField()
    name = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, min_length=2, max_length=120, required=True)
    email = serializers.EmailField(required=False, allow_null=True, default=None)
    born = serializers.DateField(required=False, allow_null=True, default=None)


class BookSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """A book: what a request may send and what a response shows."""

    id = serializers.ReadOnlyField()
    title = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, min_length=1, max_length=200, required=True)
    isbn = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, validators=[RegexValidator("^[0-9]{13}$")], required=True)
    authorId = serializers.PrimaryKeyRelatedField(queryset=Author.objects.all(), source="author", required=True)
    genre = serializers.ChoiceField(choices=Genre.choices, required=True)
    pages = serializers.IntegerField(min_value=1, max_value=5000, required=True)
    published = serializers.DateField(required=False, allow_null=True, default=None)
    available = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, default=True)

"""Settings of the API. Everything secret comes from the environment: see .env.example."""

import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path

import dj_database_url

import pymysql

# PyMySQL stands in for mysqlclient, which needs a compiler to install
pymysql.version_info = (2, 2, 1, "final", 0)
pymysql.install_as_MySQLdb()

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

# Without DJANGO_SECRET_KEY a random key is used: fine to try the API, set your own before deploying it
SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get("DJANGO_SECRET_KEY") or secrets.token_urlsafe(50)
DEBUG = os.environ.get("DJANGO_DEBUG", "false").lower() == "true"
ALLOWED_HOSTS = [host.strip() for host in os.environ.get("DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS", "localhost,127.0.0.1").split(",") if host.strip()]

INSTALLED_APPS = [
    "django.contrib.contenttypes",
    "django.contrib.auth",
    "rest_framework",
    "api",
]

MIDDLEWARE = [
    "django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware",
    "django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware",
]

# Paths have no trailing slash, as openapi.yaml describes them
APPEND_SLASH = False
ROOT_URLCONF = "config.urls"
WSGI_APPLICATION = "config.wsgi.application"

# DATABASE_URL, for example postgres://user:password@host:5432/name; TEST_DATABASE_URL replaces it in the tests
DATABASES = {
    "default": dj_database_url.parse(os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL") or os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "mysql://api:change-me@localhost:3306/api")),
}
DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD = "django.db.models.BigAutoField"

USE_TZ = True
TIME_ZONE = "UTC"

# Secret, algorithm, audience and issuer of the tokens. Without JWT_SECRET, every protected request is rejected
JWT_SECRET = os.environ.get("JWT_SECRET", "")
JWT_ALGORITHM = os.environ.get("JWT_ALGORITHM", "HS256")
JWT_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("JWT_AUDIENCE") or None
JWT_ISSUER = os.environ.get("JWT_ISSUER") or None

REST_FRAMEWORK = {
    "EXCEPTION_HANDLER": "config.errors.exception_handler",
    "DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES": ["config.security.BearerTokenAuthentication"],
    "DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES": ["rest_framework.permissions.AllowAny"],
    "UNAUTHENTICATED_USER": None,
    "DEFAULT_RENDERER_CLASSES": ["rest_framework.renderers.JSONRenderer"],
    "DEFAULT_PARSER_CLASSES": ["rest_framework.parsers.JSONParser"],
}

files.README.md:
# library-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Django REST Framework. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Python 3.12 or later.

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate        # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
export $(grep -v "^#" .env | xargs)   # after copying .env.example to .env and filling it in
python manage.py makemigrations
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver
```

The API listens on http://localhost:8000. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`. The first `makemigrations` writes the migrations of the models; keep them in your repository.

## Test it

```bash
python manage.py test
```

The tests create their own database (set `TEST_DATABASE_URL` to use a running server).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/authors` | List authors | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/authors/{id}` | Get an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/authors` | Create an author | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/authors/{id}` | Replace an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/authors/{id}` | Update part of an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/authors/{id}` | Delete an author | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books/{id}` | Get a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/books/{id}` | Replace a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{id}` | Update part of a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{id}` | Delete a book | 204 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Django ORM on mariadb. A reference to another resource is a foreign key that protects it: deleting an item others refer to answers 409. Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON fields.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a bearer token issued by your identity provider. The API verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` (and `JWT_AUDIENCE` / `JWT_ISSUER` when set), requires an expiry, and reads the roles from the `roles` claim. It does not issue tokens.

"""Tests of the authors endpoints."""


from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from tests.helpers import TEST_SETTINGS, author_payload, authorize, create_author


@TEST_SETTINGS
class AuthorsTests(APITestCase):
    """Every test starts with an empty database and a client allowed to call every endpoint."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        authorize(self.client)

    def test_create_author(self) -> None:
        payload = author_payload(self.client)
        response = self.client.post("/authors", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.content)
        created = response.json()
        self.assertIsNotNone(created["id"])
        self.assertEqual(created["name"], payload["name"])

    def test_create_author_without_name(self) -> None:
        payload = author_payload(self.client)
        del payload["name"]
        response = self.client.post("/authors", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        error = response.json()["error"]
        self.assertEqual(error["code"], "validation_error")
        self.assertTrue(any(detail["field"] == "name" for detail in error["details"]))

    def test_get_author(self) -> None:
        created = create_author(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.get(f"/authors/{key}")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json(), created)

    def test_get_missing_author(self) -> None:
        response = self.client.get("/authors/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["error"]["code"], "not_found")

    def test_list_authors(self) -> None:
        create_author(self.client)
        create_author(self.client, variant=1)
        response = self.client.get("/authors")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["page"], 1)

    def test_list_authors_by_page(self) -> None:
        create_author(self.client)
        create_author(self.client, variant=1)
        response = self.client.get("/authors", {"page": 2, "size": 1})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(response.json()["items"]), 1)

    def test_list_authors_rejects_a_bad_page(self) -> None:
        response = self.client.get("/authors", {"page": 0})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)

    def test_replace_author(self) -> None:
        created = create_author(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        payload = author_payload(self.client, variant=1)
        response = self.client.put(f"/authors/{key}", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["name"], payload["name"])

    def test_update_author(self) -> None:
        created = create_author(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.patch(f"/authors/{key}", {"name": "name 2"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["name"], "name 2")

    def test_update_author_rejects_null(self) -> None:
        created = create_author(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.patch(f"/authors/{key}", {"name": None}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)

    def test_delete_author(self) -> None:
        created = create_author(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.delete(f"/authors/{key}")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 204, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(f"/authors/{key}").status_code, 404)

    def test_list_authors_needs_credentials(self) -> None:
        self.client.credentials()
        response = self.client.get("/authors")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 401)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["error"]["code"], "unauthorized")
